item.question: Why we don't replace the blood in a sick person (HIV, cancer) with clean blood.
presuppositions: It is practical to replace the blood of a sick person to cure them.

corrections: Replacing the blood of a sick person would take a lot of blood, and there are rejection and infection risks.
